lounges.name: Concordia Lounge · International
lounges.location: Third floor of international departures, after security and immigration, reached by lift or stairs.

hours.note: Priority Pass publishes 06:00–02:00, while Plaza Premium’s booking page publishes 05:00–01:00. Confirm the applicable hours before an early or late visit.

sources.title: Plaza Premium · Concordia International facilities and hours

lounges.note: Plaza Premium now lists showers, subject to availability and possible charges; older reviews describing no showers are not used for current facilities. No alcohol is served. The current Priority Pass page does not state a maximum visit length.

qualityRating.summary: A July 2023 visit praised the natural light and coffee but reported crowding and slow buffet replenishment. This older assessment may not reflect later changes, including the shower facilities now listed by a booking partner.

sources.title: The Shutterwhale · Concordia International, July 2023 visit

lounges.name: Blue Sky Premier Lounge
lounges.location: Domestic departures, second floor near Gate 6, with seating across the second and third floors.

sources.title: Priority Pass · Blue Sky Premier Bali
Blue Sky Group · Bali lounge facilities

lounges.note: VIP rooms cost extra. Drink descriptions differ between the operator and Priority Pass, so do not assume every listed beverage is included.

recommendation.summary: A domestic-terminal option with buffet food, coffee and a shower, subject to the three-hour Priority Pass allowance.

qualityRating.summary: A February 2026 review praises the food, barista coffee and comfortable space. The lounge is a walk from security, and its single shower may require waiting; this is one reported visit.

sources.title: Live and Let’s Fly · Blue Sky Premier Bali, February 2026
